implemented_protocol.lm_ILogService: cmd0 OpenLogger: ClientProcessId placeholder plus send-PID descriptor, no input handles; real moved ILogger session or domain object through existing IPC dispatcher
implemented_protocol.ILogger: cmd0 Log: one active X or A input buffer (AutoSelect0x21); cmd1 SetDestination u32 mask
implemented_protocol.unsupported: all other request commands fail; Request cmd2 is not Flush. Existing CMIF control2 is generic clone, separate from request dispatch
implemented_protocol.packet: 24-byte header; validates payload exactly, little-endian known flags/severity; padding unspecified; snapshots readable bounded guest bytes
implemented_protocol.chunks: ULEB128 key/length streaming validation; key/length/value may span packets; head/tail checked per thread; unknown chunk keys preserved as payload metadata

real_host_behavior.sink: run/logs/guest-lm.log, owned regular0600, NOFOLLOW/openat in checked run logs directory
real_host_behavior.PID: single-process host identity (getpid), replacing untrusted packet/client placeholder PID; no PID injection needed in other IPC services
real_host_behavior.destination: service-global under lm_lock, default TargetManager1. Setting via A affects B/clones, and opening another logger does not reset it; supported masks map to the diagnostic host sink; mask0 disables payload output. No physical UART/TargetManager transport claimed
real_host_behavior.storage: hex payload records retain packet fragmentation losslessly and cannot inject terminal controls
real_host_behavior.success_condition: service/session creation or validated log/configuration writes actually completed and fsynced; budget/write failures stop
real_host_behavior.lifetime: bounded process-lifetime logger states are not freed/reused while generic IPC clone sessions can borrow them
